description: Send a mail letter to another avatar on the shard. Prerequisite: target_persist_id must resolve to a real avatar (the server looks them up via DataService.Get<Avatar>; a bad id causes the server to throw and reply SEND_FAILED); non-empty subject and body. Effect: the bot constructs a MessageItem{TargetID, Subject, Body, Type=0, Subtype=0}, wraps it in MailRequest{Type=SEND, Item=...}, and writes it on the city Aries socket. The server's MailHandler BB-sanitises the body, truncates it to 1500 chars, INSERTs a fso_inbox row with sender_id=your_persist_id, and if the target is online, pushes a MailResponse{Type=NEW_MAIL} to them immediately; otherwise they get it on their next POLL_INBOX. The sender receives MailResponse{Type=SEND_SUCCESS, Messages=[echo]} (or SEND_IGNORING_YOU / SEND_IGNORING_THEM / SEND_FAILED). Sending to yourself is legal — server creates a normal fso_inbox row. Cost: zero in-world currency. Client-side pre-wire refuse: missing target / empty subject / empty body / body > 1500 chars → ok=false with specific error.

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: Persist id (avatar id) of the recipient. Must be > 0 and typically not your own. Server does the existence check; a bogus id causes SEND_FAILED.

args.name: subject
args.description: Subject line. Must be non-empty. Server stores up to 128 chars (MariaDB varchar(128)); bot truncates defensively at 128.

args.name: body
args.description: Message body. Must be non-empty. Server BB-sanitises and caps at 1500 chars; bot refuses bodies > 1500 chars pre-wire to surface the constraint explicitly to the agent rather than silently truncate.

common_mistakes: Another send-mail already in flight → ok:false.
target_persist_id / subject / body missing or empty → ok:false.
subject > 128 chars or body > 1500 → ok:false (server caps mirror).
Server BB-sanitises body; angle brackets etc. may render differently at the target.
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (for self-send health check): perception.avatar.persist_id
Inbound NEW_MAIL pushes surface in perception.recent_events[] with kind=='mail', direction=='in' — the extras carry mail_id / sender_persist_id / subject
Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (on-lot) or from your remembered contacts
refuse_conditions: missing target_persist_id, subject, or body → ok:false
server FAILURE variants (SEND_FAILED / SEND_IGNORING_YOU / SEND_IGNORING_THEM / SEND_THROTTLED[_DAILY]) → ok:false with the enum-named reason
